name: smwgraphics-super-valis-iv-castle-vanity
title: Super Valis IV - Castle Vanity
description:
The sky background used in Castle Vanity, from Super Valis IV. As seen in the original game, this background is perfect for parallax, mainly the clouds. It can fit some sky or space level. This rip was part of my C3 Graphic Ripping Showcase .

Credit would be great, but is optional.

UPDATE: Optimized tile usage even more. Remapped palette to more appropriate palette slots.
